title: Saba and the Storm
text: Long ago, when Saba was nine, he stood on the deck of a big ship the week before Pesach. He held his little Chumash, and he wanted to keep it dry. That night, a storm rocked the ship. Waves splashed over the deck, and Saba grabbed the rail. "Hide the Chumash under your coat!" shouted his Abba. Saba pushed it under his coat and held it tight. His heart pounded the whole night. The next morning, the sky was blue and calm. At last, they reached the land. Saba opened his coat, and the Chumash was dry! He hugged it and thought, "We made it." To this day, Saba keeps that Chumash on his shelf.
